resources.string: A friendly daily companion connecting elders and family caretakers.

Care Connect only shares your schedule, hydration, tasks, and optional location with caretakers you explicitly approve using a private pairing code. You can revoke access or disable location sharing at any time.
Medicine names and dosages are entered from your prescription or by an authorized caretaker. Care Connect does not diagnose, prescribe, or recommend dosages.
Daily hydration goals are personal wellness targets configured by you or your caretaker and do not replace medical advice.
General lifestyle wellness ideas powered by AI. Not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
